calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, p.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 102
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT sku, product_name, category, subcategory, SUM(quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_distinct_rl, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
FROM lines GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_all, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_test, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(f.sale_date, r.business_date) AS d, f.units_all, f.units_test, f.receipts, f.n_lines, f.n_ids, r.units_sold, r.receipts AS rpt_receipts
FROM f FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') r ON r.business_date=f.sale_date
ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units_booked_in_period
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,103670,102233)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
